name: R2 DEMO ONLY · ETH post-only long

author.name: Platform diagnostics
author.prompt: Owner-started OKX Demo execution probe of the R2 post-only path on ETH-USDT-SWAP. Not an author strategy or profitability test.

description: Demo-only operating procedure: one ETH long as a post-only order 1 bps below the decision bar's close, resting up to 10 minutes; hosted stop on any fill; exit by stop, target or a 5-minute hold. Keep as an unpromoted draft.
original_text: In the owner's OKX Demo workshop, allocate 100 USDT and admit entries for 300 seconds. At the first visible closed minute with a known 1-minute return, place one ETH-USDT-SWAP long of 30% allocation as a post-only limit 1 bps below that bar's close, rounded down to the tick; never send it if it would cross the book. The order rests for at most 600 seconds, also after the admission cutoff, then the remainder is cancelled; an actual partial fill stays owned. Any fill gets the hosted stop. Exit: stop 50 bps, target 40 bps from the minute after the fill, or 300 seconds of holding; owner Stop, risk and recovery keep priority. No adds, no second order. This is a diagnostic demo probe of the buy side of the execution path, not evidence of profit and not a strategy for the Live arena.
